Subject: Open Office Hours — Live Inference Workshop (scheduling)

Hi all,

We're running a 45-minute Open Office Hours / Live Inference Workshop next week to demo Redwood's hosted inference workflows, show a short walkthrough of batching/cache controls, and take live Q&A. The goal is a hands-on session for engineering and platform teams — no sales deck.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 20, 11:00–11:45 AM
- Wed Apr 21, 3:00–3:45 PM

If either of those works, please reply with the slot you prefer. If neither works, tell us a couple of 30–60 minute windows and we'll try to accommodate multiple teams in breakout groups. We'll send a calendar invite with a Meet link once we lock the time.

Agenda (attached): 20m demo + 15m live troubleshooting + 10m Q&A. I've attached the agenda and a short example prompt set so you can surface any questions about reproducibility or latency ahead of time.

Attachments: 2026-04-15_office-hours-agenda.pdf (agenda, 2 pages), sample-prompt-set.xlsx (example prompts)

If you prefer a dedicated 30-min team demo instead of the group office hours, let me know and we'll book a separate slot.

Thanks — looking forward,

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
